description: Incremental runs with a delta token (docs/incremental.md): run 1 pages through /users/delta and stores the delta link of the last page; run 2 resumes from it and gets a changed user, a deletion (@removed, emitted as op delete) and a new user; run 3 resumes from the next link and gets nothing; run 4 is a reconciliation run that reads the full snapshot again, so the deleted user comes back and the changed one changes back.
